about: Generated by CommandRegistry.main (docs/commands.md). Every HelioFITS Studio command, in the shape of an MCP tools list. Ids are API: never renamed.

tools.name: exportSessionWithData
tools.description: Save the session plus a .data.zip of its local files, to open on another computer

tools.name: zoomTimelineFit
tools.description: Set the timeline window to the time bounds of the loaded layers

tools.name: displaySettings
tools.description: Text size and interface scale: make the app easier to read

tools.name: fitNewMultiviewLayers
tools.description: Fit a layer added in multiview to its own view (with Separate Multiview Zoom)

tools.name: present
tools.description: Presentation mode: output only, fullscreen (Esc to leave)

tools.name: punchLatest
tools.description: Open the newest day of PUNCH clear average mosaics (CAM) in Helioradial with RHEF

tools.name: sendToPython
tools.description: Write the active layer's FITS files as double-precision science FITS plus a manifest and a sunpy snippet

tools.name: sdoCutout
tools.description: Open LMSAL's AIA cut-out service for the enabled AIA layers and the current view

tools.name: takeTour
tools.description: Step through the main controls, one at a time

tools.name: welcome
tools.description: What's new in this version, and the ways to start

tools.name: tipOfTheDay
tools.description: A short tip you have not seen yet, with Show Me to point at the control it is about

tools.name: showImageLayers
tools.description: Open the Image Layers section, wherever it is docked

tools.name: sendFeedback
tools.description: Send a problem, a request or a question to the developer; no account needed

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undo the last change to the scene

tools.name: redo
tools.description: Redo the last undone change to the scene

tools.name: copyFrame
tools.description: Put the canvas picture on the clipboard (a screenshot, 8-bit)

tools.name: quickShare
tools.description: Record one loop as a movie that plays anywhere, then show it in the file manager; your recording settings are not changed

tools.name: shareScene
tools.description: Save the scene for someone else: home folder written as ~, local files outside the cache listed first

tools.name: datasetFolders
tools.description: Browse the cache as one folder per dataset (links, or a files.txt listing on Windows); the cache is not changed

tools.name: openExportsFolder
tools.description: Show the folder movies, screenshots and metadata are exported to

tools.name: study
tools.description: What a scene exports: a table of views to export as a set (projection, lambda, field of view, layers), and study templates to start one from

tools.name: taskManager
tools.description: What is downloading, loading or computing, and the export queue (also: click the footer's spinner)

tools.name: studySaveView
tools.description: Add the view on screen to the Study table as a new row

tools.name: searchControls
tools.description: Find any command or control by name and run it or show where it is

tools.name: showProjection
tools.description: Open the Projection palette, wherever it is docked

tools.name: openDemo
tools.description: A new session with a bundled SDO/AIA 171 image and RHEF on; nothing to download

tools.name: showPlayback
tools.description: Open the Playback and Recording section, wherever it is docked

tools.name: duplicateLayer
tools.description: Add a copy of the selected image layer, for a before and after with the Compare palette

tools.name: newFromTemplate
tools.description: Start from a template: a saved scene whose dates can follow the newest data

tools.name: saveAsTemplate
tools.description: Save this scene as a template: a starting point with a name, a description, a thumbnail and a time rule

tools.name: templates
tools.description: Manage scene templates: open, duplicate, rename, edit, share, set as startup or retire

tools.name: toolbarManager
tools.description: Choose which tools are on the toolbar and in what order (unlocks the panels first when they are locked)

tools.name: cacheManager
tools.description: What is on disk, in Studio's cache and the FITS library: load, reveal, import, verify or delete

frame.description: Frame number, 0 is the first frame

tools.name: seekFrame
tools.description: Show the movie frame with this number (0 is the first)

tools.name: seekTime
tools.description: Move the movie to the frame nearest this time

tools.name: rotateView90
tools.description: Rotate the view 90 degrees about one axis of the screen

wait.description: Answer when every frame is loaded (default), when the first is shown, or at once

source.description: jp2: Helioviewer pictures over JPIP; fits-library: the HelioFITS Core cache on this computer

cadence_s.description: jp2 only: wanted spacing in seconds; omit for the server's default

dataset.description: jp2: the dataset as the server lists it, e.g. 'AIA 193' (with observatory); fits-library: a Core dataset key or uid

tools.name: layerAdd
tools.description: Add an image layer for a dataset over a time range and wait for its frames

tools.name: layerList
tools.description: The image layers in the scene, with their ids

tools.name: layerRemove
tools.description: Remove an image layer from the scene

tools.name: layerReload
tools.description: Read a layer's frames again; a FITS library layer queries the cache afresh, so files added since are picked up

params.description: The layer's image parameters by the names a saved session uses: clippingMode, clippingMin, clippingMax, scalingMode, gamma, beta, alpha, plane, subtractBackground, and the display settings

tools.name: filterSet
tools.description: Set a layer's image filter and its FITS display parameters

zoom.description: Zoom by this factor, above 1 closer

warp_lambda.description: Box-Cox radial lambda of the helioradial projections

tools.name: viewSet
tools.description: Set the view: projection, zoom, Box-Cox lambda, tracking, corona

frame.description: Frame number, 0 is the first; default the frame on screen

tools.name: frameGet
tools.description: Write one FITS frame's decoded values, as the layer shows them before any colour table, to an hf-decode-dump/1 document and return its path

long_side.description: Pixels on the long side; omit for the export size in the settings

tools.name: previewRender
tools.description: Render the scene as an export would, to a PNG in Studio's cache (not among the exports), and return its path

long_side.description: Pixels on the long side; omit for the export size in the settings

tools.name: exportStill
tools.description: Export the frame on screen as a PNG, with its processing record beside it

long_side.description: Pixels on the long side; omit for the export size in the settings

tools.name: exportMovie
tools.description: Export one loop of the loaded frames as a movie in the format the settings choose, with its processing record beside it

tools.name: listCommands
tools.description: List every command: its id, what it does and what it changes

id.description: A command id or a control id, as listCommands or Help > Search Controls shows

tools.name: describeControl
tools.description: Say what a command or control is, where it is, its shortcut, and which tours and tips show it
